assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq of gastrocnemius-plantaris (GP) muscle, male C57BL/6 mice (S2.8.p1)
sample_inclusion: Exercised NPE (n=5) and HPE (n=4) sequenced in this study (GSE325957); sedentary NPS/HPS (n=3 each) are the previously published samples from GSE120958 (Peri-Okonny et al. 2019) (S2.8.p1, S9.p1, S3.7.p1, FIG6 n=3-5)
primary_estimand: Effect of exercise training on GP muscle gene expression within each diet (NPS vs NPE; HPS vs HPE), and the diet-dependence of that response
planned_contrasts: NPE vs NPS (S3.7.p1; Table S2; paper: 9467 DEGs, 4540 up / 4927 down)
HPE vs HPS (S3.7.p1; Table S3; paper: 8009 DEGs, 3883 up / 4126 down)
HPS vs NPS (diet, sedentary; S3.7.p1; count not stated)
HPE vs NPE (diet, exercised; S3.7.p2; Table S8; paper: 10 DEGs)
paper_method: featureCounts read counts; DESeq2 v1.50.2 Wald test, BH FDR, on NPE/HPE samples together with GSE120958 (S2.8.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: SUP5/SUP6/SUP11 (Tables S2, S3, S8: p_adj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.5); S2.8.p1
